title: Remote viewers describe the anomaly as a constructed gold energy source
summary: Dennis Asberg tells of Remote viewers describe the anomaly as a constructed gold energy source, about 2025 at Baltic Sea anomaly, between Sweden and Finland, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Oh, that is constructed and it's some of us have it made of gold.

plain: A treasure hunter named Dennis Asberg, talking with podcast host Jesse Michels, describes a strange round shape his team found on the floor of the Baltic Sea between Sweden and Finland. He says remote viewers, people who claim to see distant things with the mind alone, including Joseph McMoneagle and Angela Ford, looked at it in 2025 and said it was built, a kind of energy source, and that some saw it as made of gold.
